name: sitegraph-seo
description: Audit a WordPress site with SiteGraph SEO Agent, explain which pages are weak and why, and fix internal links and search snippets as reviewable changesets with undo and redo.

mcp_url.title: SiteGraph MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Your site's SiteGraph endpoint, shown in wp-admin under SiteGraph SEO → Connect an agent, e.g. https://example.com/wp-json/sitegraph/v1/mcp

access_token.title: Access token
access_token.description: The access token generated under SiteGraph SEO → Connect an agent. It is a WordPress Application Password you can revoke at any time.
